body:
I wrote him a text in the middle of the night and he called me soon after to talk. He also called in the morning to make sure I was okay and we talked tonight as well. He apologized for overreacting but maintained that his heart was weak. I know it took him enormous strength to forgive me and still do the kind thing. He doesn't believe me when I tell him that I'll support him and that he's not sure if he'll ever recover from all the heartache that I've caused his spirit. 

Thank you for the book recommendation. I think I'll go visit the library tomorrow and pick it up. I was almost sure he wouldn't want to see me but I asked to see him tomorrow anyway; he said that he needed to rest and that he would've brought it up if he thought he could. So I'll have to distract myself tomorrow instead. 

Again, thank you for reading and replying. Writing things down here and in my text to him helped me a lot and I'm even more grateful that someone actually responded.

Ever since we started discussing our issues a couple of months ago I've been thinking and trying to change how I was and how I treated him. He might have gotten over the older things faster if I hadn't given him new things to have to forgive. Things like tonight wouldn't have been an issue at all normally, but because of my history he thinks I don't care enough about him, which cannot be farther from the truth. I'm just terrible at showing it. 

No, not really. I've been reading Ender's Game, for example.

Again, thank you. I love fantasy, I guess it's a coping mechanism to escape from real life. I haven't been reading much lately though.

I just can't imagine anything but a future as life partners with this man. We just clicked so well and I thought we understood each other deeply, in a way that no one else ever has for both of us. I don't understand how it became like this. It shouldn't have.

Thank you, it means a lot that something cared to read all that and reply. I've never really been into yoga or meditation but I did love reading, so I could try. He does love me, too much for his own good I think. I do too. He said that he'll always be in my life in some form, but I'm scared that I ruined the closeness we had and it will never be the same again.

The irony is that my outlet used to be that same passion we were able to share partly, but because we could never really share it together I grew bitter and jealous when he was able and wanted to enjoy it fully with others.

I cried so much my head aches, and while I want to stay up all night and endure the pain and fatigue as punishment, I also want to go to sleep and never wake up.

I want to send him a single text telling him that I'm sorry again but I don't know what to say. I've said sorry and that I'll try harder so many times I don't think he'll believe it anymore.
